title: ServiceErrorToProcessFailedEvents
description: The on-failure destination record the AWS Lambda service sends to the failed-events SQS queue, read by job-failed, when an asynchronous invocation of process-summary, process-issues or setup-project fails for good: its retries run out, it times out or crashes, or the event passes its maximum age. Only the fields job-failed reads are described; every other field is allowed and ignored. The record's shape and its condition values are not yet confirmed against a deployed function.

requestId.description: The asynchronous invocation's request ID; it identifies a setup-project failure, which has no job.

condition.description: Why Lambda gave up, e.g. RetriesExhausted.

functionArn.description: The ARN of the function that failed.

requestPayload.description: The failed invocation's payload, as the function received it (handoff_to_process_summary, handoff_to_process_tickets or handoff_to_setup_project). It may hold summary text, so it is never stored or logged.

responsePayload.description: The function's error. Absent or null if there is none to report, e.g. possibly when the event expired.

errorType.description: The error's type, e.g. an exception class name such as LeaseHeld. Absent or null if Lambda reports none.
